intro.title: An association built as a bridge.
intro.body: Founded in Singapore in 2025, GACEE is a non-profit association linking China and the world through education. We work with schools, universities, publishers, cultural institutions, technology partners and philanthropic organisations to create exchange that lasts beyond a single event.

items.title: International Chinese education
items.body: Connecting Chinese-language schools and institutions worldwide, and bringing quality teaching resources, teachers and curricula to them.

items.title: Cultural exchange
items.body: Reading, writing, publishing, heritage crafts and theatre, presented in ways that are young, contemporary and international.

items.title: AI and the future of learning
items.body: Exploring the capabilities young people will need in an AI era, with teachers leading and technology in support.

items.title: Global youth exchange
items.body: Competitions, study journeys, school partnerships and international youth projects that build both roots and a global outlook.

items.title: Public good
items.body: Free public lectures, reading initiatives, volunteering and support for children with special needs, so education reaches more people.

programmes.title: Flagship programmes
programmes.body: Each programme is designed as a long-term platform rather than a one-off event: principals lead to schools, schools lead to students, and students lead to lasting partnerships.

principals-tour.title: Global 100 Principals China Tour
principals-tour.tagline: Principals as bridges between schools and China
principals-tour.summary: An annual programme bringing one hundred school leaders from Chinese-language schools worldwide into China for education dialogue, school visits and cultural immersion.
body: Three editions have been held in Henan Province, welcoming 180 principals from 34 countries. Each edition combines education forums, visits to Chinese schools, exchanges between principals and immersive experiences of Chinese culture and heritage.

The fourth edition will extend the programme beyond Henan, with Anhui and the Hangzhou–Shaoxing region under consideration. It moves from cultural visits towards deeper education exchange, technology and future-of-learning themes, and concrete school-to-school cooperation: student visits, shared curricula and long-term partnerships.
Our principle is one region per edition, one culture per place, and one lasting connection per exchange.

composition-competition.title: World Chinese Composition Competition
composition-competition.tagline: Chinese connects the world; writing connects the future
composition-competition.summary: A global writing competition for primary and secondary students, with published anthologies and study-journey awards for outstanding entrants.
body: Launched in May 2025, the first edition reached more than one hundred schools in over thirty countries across five continents, with more than ten thousand student entries in three age groups. Outstanding works were published in an anthology that drew wide international media attention.

The second edition, themed "Chinese connects the world: my cultural journey", invites students to write about culture, characters, AI, the future and growing up. Winners receive study-journey opportunities in China and learning support.
From a single composition to an understanding of a culture; from a competition to a lasting platform connecting young people worldwide with China.

study-tours.title: International Study Journeys
study-tours.tagline: From writing about China to walking through it
study-tours.summary: Immersive study journeys that take young people from the China they wrote about into the China they can see, hear and touch.
body: The first journey, "Walking China, Continuing the Legacy", brought outstanding competition entrants into heritage sites, intangible cultural heritage workshops and modern technology, guided by scholars and heritage masters.
The second journey departed for Xi'an on 30 August 2026, exploring the ancient capital of thirteen dynasties from historical relics to contemporary urban life.

New routes are in development: Anhui for Hui culture and historic villages; Chaoshan for Lingnan culture, folk traditions and cuisine. Each route is a walking classroom with its own mentors, from academics to heritage bearers.

principals-forum.title: Global Chinese Principals Forum
principals-forum.tagline: A high-level forum on the future of international Chinese education
principals-forum.summary: An annual forum where school leaders and education experts examine teaching innovation and the transformation of Chinese-language education in the AI era.
body: The forum was held in Zhengzhou on 1 April 2025, organised with the Secondary School Students' Study Newspaper. It examined education philosophy, teaching methods, innovation and directions for transformation, and was warmly received by principals and international educators.
The forum runs alongside the Principals Tour, turning a visit into a professional community.

online-chinese.title: Global Online Chinese Programme
online-chinese.tagline: Teacher-led, AI-assisted, built for the hardest-to-connect classrooms
online-chinese.summary: Live and recorded Chinese courses taught by experienced teachers, designed to keep working on weak networks and offline. First cohorts run in Nigeria.
body: The programme began with online Chinese training for Great Heights School and New Horizon School in Nigeria. It pairs remote teachers with local classrooms, and is being developed with a technology partner into a learning platform aligned with international Chinese proficiency standards.

Our design principles are firm: teachers lead and sign off every key judgement; AI assists with practice, review and feedback; content stays within verified knowledge; and weak connectivity and offline use are treated as the default, not an afterthought. Learners' first languages are used as scaffolding, with Swahili, French, Arabic and English support planned.
Compliance, data protection and school-level data separation are built into the foundation from day one.

future-academy.title: Future Academy
future-academy.tagline: Rooted in culture, open to the world, ready for what comes next
future-academy.summary: An international curriculum for young people, in four strands: Chinese culture and language, world civilisations, AI and future capabilities, and personal growth through practice.
body: Future Academy is GACEE's international education framework. It combines courses, reading, study journeys, practical projects and international exchange to develop young people with cultural roots, a global outlook, independent thinking, creativity and social responsibility.

The four strands: Chinese culture and language; world civilisations and global competence; AI literacy, scientific enquiry and interdisciplinary learning; and growth through debate, leadership, service and project-based learning.
The path runs from curriculum to international classroom, to study journeys, to global exchange, to a community of young people growing up together across countries.

public-good.title: Public Lectures and EduLink-Africa
public-good.tagline: Education is the spark that lights the future
public-good.summary: Free public lectures for schools and communities worldwide, and EduLink-Africa, our education support initiative for African schools.
body: GACEE's public lecture series brings educators and experts to schools and communities free of charge, covering reading, culture, learning in the AI era and family education.
EduLink-Africa supports schools in Africa with learning resources, teacher connections and infrastructure. We are not only builders; we want every child to have the chance to pursue a dream.
All public-good programmes are clearly marked, free to participants, and funded through the association and its philanthropic partners.

about.title: From Singapore, connecting China and the world.
about.lede: GACEE was founded in Singapore in 2025 as an international platform for cultural and educational exchange. Culture is our root, education our bridge, and young people our future.
about.mission: To link global resources in education, culture, technology and public good; to bring the best of Chinese culture to the world; and to foster exchange and mutual learning between civilisations.
about.vision: Culture beyond borders, education connecting the future: an open, shared and sustainable global ecosystem for cultural and educational cooperation.

values.title: Education as a public good
values.body: We keep the public-interest character of education at the centre of everything we do.

values.title: Teachers first
values.body: In every programme, including those using AI, teachers lead and technology supports.

values.title: Facts before claims
values.body: We say what we did, how many, and where, before we say what it means.

values.title: Start where it is hardest
values.body: If a programme works in the most difficult conditions, it will work anywhere.

strategy: Build a portfolio of internationally recognised flagship programmes.
Grow a global network for Chinese-language education across schools, institutions and experts.
Establish a lasting system of two-way youth exchange between China and the world.
Deepen the integration of culture, technology and education.
Bring quality cultural and educational content to international audiences.
Develop an open, cross-sector platform for global cultural and educational cooperation.

privacy: This notice explains how the Global Association of Cultural and Educational Exchange ("GACEE", "we") handles personal data on gacee.org, in line with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act.

What we collect: information you give us when you register for an event, submit a competition entry, subscribe to updates or contact us, such as your name, organisation, email address and, for competitions, a participant's age group and school. We collect only what a programme needs.
Children: entries and registrations for participants under 18 require the consent of a parent or guardian, including for any publication of a participant's work or image.
How we use it: to run the programme you asked about, to communicate with you about it, and, with your consent, to send occasional updates. We do not sell personal data.
Where it is kept: core data is stored in Singapore. Where a programme involves partners in other countries, we tell you at the point of collection.
Your rights: you may ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, or withdraw consent, by writing to info@gacee.org. Our Data Protection Officer can be reached at the same address.
This site uses privacy-respecting analytics without cookies that track you across sites.
terms: By using gacee.org you agree to these terms. The site is operated by the Global Association of Cultural and Educational Exchange, a non-profit association registered in Singapore.
Content on this site, including text, images and the GACEE seal, belongs to GACEE or its licensors and may not be reproduced without permission, except for fair quotation with attribution.
Event registrations and competition entries are governed by the rules published for each programme, including any fees, refund conditions and consent requirements.
